shortDescription: Eastern Mediterranean-focused gas producer Energean LSE:ENOG posted a 45% jump in first-half profit on Wednesday, helped by the recognition of deferred tax assets in Italy, and reiterated its annual output forecast after the restart of its Israeli operations.
